Fitness Tips

From the coaches

How to start lifting safely

Begin with bodyweight and light loads to learn the movement.

Read more

Master the squat, hinge, push and pull first. Add weight only when every rep looks the same. Train 3 days a week and ask a coach to check your form.

What to eat before training

Fuel matters more than most beginners think.

Read more

Have carbs and some protein 1–2 hours before, such as a banana with curd or poha with eggs. After training, add protein and fluids within two hours.

Why recovery is part of the plan

Progress happens between sessions, not during them.

Read more

Sleep 7–9 hours, keep one or two lighter days each week, and use mobility work to keep joints healthy so you can train for years.
